decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. We are adding a $5 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100).
